title: Shooter
summary: An arena shooter. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse and hold the left button to fire. Reach a score to win.

parts.what: TopDownController moves with WASD. Shooter fires prefabs/shooter_bullet.prefab toward the mouse while the left button is held.
parts.try: Lower Cooldown to 0.08 for a machine gun, or raise Bullet Speed.

parts.what: Each bullet has Hazard with Victim Tag 'enemy' and Vanish On Hit, so it hurts enemies and disappears. Lifetime removes bullets that miss.
parts.try: Open the prefab (double-click it in Assets) and make bullets bigger.

parts.what: A Spawner that keeps making copies of prefabs/shooter_enemy.prefab. Enemies Chase the hero and have Health; their script adds a point when they're destroyed.
parts.try: Set Max Alive to 8 on one door for chaos.

parts.what: Its script (scripts/shooter_win.es) watches game.score and shows the message at 20.
